key_idea: Restrict the problem to a smooth cubic where 9 points have zero normal displacement, then collide the remaining points to obtain a limiting jet matrix of theta functions whose full rank follows from combinatorial polynomial interpolation.
reason: The proof elegantly chains together a sequence of highly surprising conceptual reductions, transforming a difficult algebraic geometry problem into one of combinatorial interpolation. The structure is direct and the final bounds beautifully explain why the strict square-root inequality holds without resorting to brute force.
recognized: Proof of the Nagata conjecture for r >= 10
